title: Filling up your information service form
body: To be able to best evaluate your profile and visa application chances, some information about yourself will be collected.

title: Pay the service fee
body: You will receive an invoice letter with the details for payment in your email for the service(s) you chose. If you have successfully transferred the payment, send us a copy of this transaction for proof of payment. We will confirm the payment as soon as it’s received.

title: Your 1 hour consultation call
body: We will conduct a one-on-one virtual consultation call for your visa application process. We will discuss, plan strategically and assess all the documentations we will be preparing for your visa application.

title: Collecting your visa documents
body: We will send you the list of requirements you need to gather on your end. Meanwhile, we will be working on the major supporting documents (Scheduling an appointment, fill-up application form, etc) as stated on the visa services you have chosen.

title: Review of your documents
body: Send us your documents at least one week before your visa appointment so we can review them and ensure nothing is missing or wrong.
body_sub2: Submit all documents together. Partial submissions will not be accepted.

title: Attend your visa demand appointment
body: After making sure you have all your documents in order, go to your visa demand appointment.
body_sub2: Do not be late, do not forget your passport, submit ALL your documents, have a positive attitude.

title: Wait for the result
body: Once you have submitted all the requirements, the visa centre will forward your application to the Embassy/consulate you are applying for.
body_sub2: Embassy’s standard processing timeline is from 15-30 days
